# SrS Logics

> SrS Logics is a founder-led custom software company based in Nagpur, India. It designs internal business software, workflow systems, dashboards, finance tools, reporting platforms, and institution-specific systems for clients across India and the UAE.

Last updated: 2026-07-29
Canonical website: https://srslogics.com/

## Canonical identity

- Preferred name: SrS Logics
- Alternate brand spellings: srslogics, srs logics, SRS Logics, SRSLogics
- Founder: Shubham Singh
- Operating base: Nagpur, Maharashtra, India
- Markets served: India, UAE, and selected remote engagements
- Email: shubhamsingh@srslogics.com
- Telephone: +91 9270925106

## What SrS Logics does

SrS Logics builds custom software when a business or institution has outgrown spreadsheets, disconnected tools, or generic SaaS products. Systems are structured around the client's real workflow, roles, approvals, reporting requirements, data flow, and management visibility.

Core capabilities:

- Custom business software development
- Internal workflow and approval systems
- Finance, billing, stock, and payment platforms
- Management dashboards and reporting systems
- Business data analysis systems
- Education management and institutional ERP systems
- Workflow automation for operational teams

## Delivery and commercial facts

- Typical focused software delivery: approximately 4 to 6 weeks, depending on scope and review speed
- Typical post-launch support: 6 months unless revised in the engagement terms
- Typical India project range: Rs.30,000 to Rs.5 Lakhs, depending on scope and engineering requirements
- Institutional software range: Rs.6 Lakhs to Rs.15 Lakhs with a typical 16 to 18 week delivery horizon
- Typical UAE project range: AED 15,000 to AED 200,000, depending on complexity and system depth
- Final scope, delivery time, and price are confirmed only after requirement review

- [KNP Signature](https://srslogics.com/case-studies/knp-enterprise-finance/): Finance operations system covering billing, stock, payments, balances, and management visibility
